text:
maria (Support): FYI customer acme-prod reports intermittent 502/504s hitting hosted /v1/generate around 09:10 UTC. They say it happens during large embed batches. Provided a trace id: trace-89b3a.

olga (DevEx): Can you paste a minimal repro curl + headers? also which tenant/region?

maria (Support): tenant=acme-prod, region=us-west-2. Sample curl they used:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -H "X-Model: text-embed-xxl" 
  --data-binary @payload.json
```
payload.json is ~1.8MB per request, they run ~40 concurrent requests as part of a batch.

alex (Eng SRE): I pulled edge logs for trace-89b3a. Seeing a bunch of upstream resets and "upstream prematurely closed connection" from frontdoor -> thin-proxy. Example excerpt:
```
[09:11:02.123] frontdoor: upstream reset: code=RST_STREAM, stream=1532
[09:11:02.124] thin-proxy: connection pool exhausted: h2_keepalive_pool=100%
[09:11:02.125] nginx: 502 while reading response header from upstream
```

kevin (Oncall): Metrics: 5xx spike 09:10-09:18 (p95 502 rate x12), h2 keepalive utilization hitting pool cap on frontdoor hosts. Auth rotation events at 09:09:56 but only ~0.5% token churn. Looks like connection-window exhaustion not auth failures.

tara (Customer Success): Customer says after retries many requests succeed; they're worried about SLAs and want a mitigation while engineering investigates.

maria (Support): Repro steps we validated locally: run 30-50 concurrent embed requests with payloads >=1.5MB for ~5 minutes. Repro is noisy but consistent on us-west-2 frontdoor.

olga (DevEx): Can you include the exact request/response headers? we need X-Request-Id and X-Trace for the ticket.

maria (Support): Example response header from a 502:
```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: nginx
Date: Tue, 09 Mar 2026 09:11:02 GMT
Content-Type: text/html
X-Request-Id: req-89b3a-02
X-Trace: trace-89b3a
```

alex (Eng SRE): Short-term mitigations we propose:
- throttle per-tenant concurrent embed streams to 8 (config flag route-level)
- temporarily increase frontdoor h2 keepalive pool size by +30% (capacity theta)
- force a graceful thin-proxy restart on affected nodes (redeploy small).

deploy-bot: deploy started: frontdoor/keepalive-cap-bump -> rolling to 6 hosts :construction:

kevin (Oncall): I'll trigger a controlled thin-proxy restart on the 4 hosts showing pool saturation. Watchdog configured to avoid eviction.

alex (Eng SRE): Long-term: fix h2 conn-window accounting leak in thin-proxy (we have a patch branch), and add prefix/KV caching for embed prefixes to reduce concurrent load. Hypothesis: large streaming payloads + persistent h2 streams + occasional auth rotation causes ephemeral conn churn and connection window exhaustion -> upstream RST/GOAWAY -> 502/504.

maria (Support): Customer accepted per-tenant concurrency cap while we patch. They want guidance for their engineers: chunk payloads or backoff.

olga (DevEx): Draft KB for the customer: "If you see 502/504 spikes during large embedding batches: 1) reduce concurrent streams (<=8), 2) chunk payloads <1MB, 3) implement exponential backoff on 5xx, 4) provide X-Request-Id for us to triage." I'll paste a short snippet: 
```
# recommended client pattern
for batch in batches(parallel=8):
  try: call_embed(batch)
  except 5xx: sleep(backoff)
```

tara (Customer Success): Sending the KB to acme-prod now, they asked for ETA on engineering fix.

alex (Eng SRE): ETA for patch -> code review today, can ship patch to thin-proxy in ~48h, hotfix to bump pool config already rolling. Monitoring dashboard: https://telemetry.redwood/edgesla/keepalive-usage?trace=trace-89b3a

kevin (Oncall): Post-mitigation checks: 1) observed drop in 502 rate after cap applied (~70% reduction), 2) keepalive pool usage back to normal after thin-proxy restart. Will keep an eye for 12h.

maria (Support): I'll update the support ticket with repro, mitigation, trace links, and the temporary cap. Customer requested follow-up in 24h with status. :thumbsup:

olga (DevEx): I'll convert this thread into a short runbook and add to docs: "Edge 502s during heavy embedding streams."

maria (Support): closing loop once 24h no regressions. Thanks team.
